pages.title: Twelve Dockets
pages.text: A senior Foreman's office wall holds, in order, twelve framed dockets. Each marks a level of Charter recognition.$(br2)Most Foremen will earn five or six. A few earn nine. The full row of twelve — one for every act of a Foreman's tenure plus the brass-trimmed Project Manager — is rare enough that the Charter prints a roll-call once a year.$(br2)Type $(l)/skyforge office$() to see your own wall, however many it currently holds.

pages.title: The Row, In Order
pages.text: $(l) 1.$() Foreman of Record$(br)$(l) 2.$() First Smoke Filed$(br)$(l) 3.$() Builder of Record (Erik signs)$(br)$(l) 4.$() Iron Bellows Operator$(br)$(l) 5.$() Sky Wright$(br)$(l) 6.$() Federation Liaison$(br)$(l) 7.$() Workshop Foreman$(br)$(l) 8.$() Sky Captain$(br)$(l) 9.$() Frontier Engineer$(br)$(l)10.$() Citadel Witness$(br)$(l)11.$() Brass Hall Councilor$(br)$(l)12.$() Project Manager

The twelfth — $(l)Project Manager$() — is brass-trimmed. The Charter awards it when a senior Foreman has filed a Project Docket of 25 or more independent automation pages.$(br2)It is the only docket on the wall that is not about $(o)what you built$() — it is about $(o)how much of it runs without you$().
